fock_paper.title: A Fock-space inequality and the Laughlin spectral gap

stability_paper.title: Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap

physics_conventions.geometry: round sphere; fixed magnetic length convention
physics_conventions.one_particle_space: spin-Q/2 representation of SU(2); lowest Landau level dimension Q+1
physics_conventions.pair_projector: orthogonal projector onto pair relative angular momentum one (equivalently pair spin Q-1)
physics_conventions.normalization: each unordered pair projector has coefficient exactly one
physics_conventions.ground_state: unique Laughlin line generated by product_(i<j)(u_i*v_j-u_j*v_i)^3 at the stated flux
physics_conventions.potential_operator: T_Q(phi) = Pi_Q M_phi Pi_Q on the lowest Landau level; V_(N,Q)(phi) = sum_i T_Q(phi)^(i)

fock_inequality.statement: For every 0 < gamma < gammaStar there exists Q_gamma such that for all Q >= Q_gamma, H_Q^2 >= gamma*H_Q on the full fermionic Fock space.

finite_spherical_gap_1_25.statement: For sufficiently large N at Q=3*(N-1), (1/25)*distanceToLaughlinSq(psi) <= energy(psi) for every antisymmetric state.
finite_spherical_gap_1_25.dependency_note: The proof composes the Fock-space kernel-distance estimate with the Laughlin zero-kernel identification (HaldaneKernelInput).

finite_spherical_gap_1_100.statement: For sufficiently large N at Q=3*(N-1), (1/100)*distanceToLaughlinSq(psi) <= energy(psi) for every antisymmetric state.
finite_spherical_gap_1_100.note: This is a weaker separately formalized finite-spherical statement. Keep it distinct from the 1/25 sharp comparator target and Fock gammaStar statement.

planar_endpoint.statement: The untruncated planar model satisfies the endpoint gammaStar inequality on each homogeneous particle sector.

bounded_scalar_disorder_stability.paper_statement: There exist lambdaStar>0, DeltaStar>0 and NStar such that for every N>=NStar, every bounded real measurable scalar potential phi on the sphere with ||phi||_infinity<=1, and every |lambda|<=lambdaStar, the projected LLL perturbation H_(N,Q)+lambda*V_(N,Q)(phi) has a unique ground state and spectral gap at least DeltaStar, uniformly in N and potential profile.
bounded_scalar_disorder_stability.scope_note_text: The formalization includes the unperturbed Fock-space inequality used in the stability argument. Stability under projected one-body potentials and uniqueness of the perturbed ground state are outside it.
bounded_scalar_disorder_stability.claim_ceiling: The stability theorem is stated and proved in the October 5 paper, but it must not be described as Lean-formalized on the basis of the unperturbed Fock-gap declarations.

comparator_suite.placeholder_note: Comparator challenge statement modules intentionally contain sorry; their separate solution modules are the proof targets. Do not misreport these placeholders as failed proof builds.

normalization_crosswalk.one_twenty_fifth: Sharp finite spherical inequality in the Fock/LaughlinGap formal declaration; derived through a Fock-kernel-distance theorem plus zero-mode uniqueness.
normalization_crosswalk.one_hundredth: Separate weaker finite spherical inequality in OAI.Analysis.Laughlin.Main.mainTarget_proved and its comparator target.
normalization_crosswalk.gamma_star: Asymptotic Fock-space square inequality coefficient; gammaStar = 0.04616733319001 > 0.04. It is not interchangeable with an explicit finite-N disorder threshold or with the perturbed gap DeltaStar.
normalization_crosswalk.unresolved_detail: The scope note and comparator declarations must be interpreted with their exact state norm/energy normalization; do not summarize all three constants as the same 'gap'.
